rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a soccer or football goalkeeper.

example.english: The goalkeeper saved several dangerous shots in this match.
example.traditional: 今場波個守門員救咗幾球險波。
example.jyutping: gam1 coeng4 bo1 go3 sau2 mun4 jyun4 gau3 zo2 gei2 kau4 him2 bo1

rows.note: Use this colloquial football term when the context is clearly about the player guarding the goal, especially in phrases such as 踢龍門.

example.english: When we play football, Ming automatically goes in goal as the goalkeeper.
example.traditional: 我哋踢波嗰陣，阿明自動波去踢龍門。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 tek3 bo1 go2 zan6 aa3 ming4 zi6 dung6 bo1 heoi3 tek3 lung4 mun4
